description: Every 1922-44 Dail general-election contest from Gallagher: first preferences, and the count tables where printed. Figures only. Arrays per candidate (transfers, printedTotals, runningTotals) are indexed like countNumbers; printedTotals is null where Gallagher leaves the total blank, and runningTotals then carries the previous total plus the transfer.
